verdict.rationale: The CRA is a government service, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair axis to ask about. Nothing in the evidence shows the CRA publishes one. The only machine channel documented is EFILE via certified tax software, which is a different, adjacent mechanism, and the probe found no llms.txt or agent-oriented docs on canada.ca.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
